description: Moderate a community entry as the app owner: approve or reject a pending entry, remove a published one, or restore a rejected/removed one. `reject` and `remove` require a `reason` from the fixed taxonomy; the author receives the reason and your `message` live (communityUpdated) and in their own list. `remove` keeps the entry and its payload so an appeal can be honoured.

message.description: Plain-text explanation the author will read

name: neblla_moderate_community_entry
